articles.text: TÓNGXUÉ A: Wǒ tīngshuō Wáng Tāode fùqin sǐ le.
CLASSMATE A: I hear that Wáng Tāo's father died.
TÓNGXUÉ B: Shì. Wáng Tāo hé tā mǔqin xià Xīngqīyī yào bǎ lǎoxiānshengde gǔhuī sònghuiqu.
CLASSMATE B: Yes. Wáng Tāo and his mother are going to take the old gentleman's ashes back next Monday.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Tāmen lǎojiā zài nǎr?
CLASSMATE A: Where's their family from?
TÓNGXUÉ B: Zài Guǎngdōng.
CLASSMATE B: Guǎngdōng.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Tīngshuō Wáng Lǎoxiānsheng huózhede shíhou chángcháng xǐhuan tán lǎojiāde shìr?
CLASSMATE A: I understand that when Mr. Wáng was alive he often liked to talk about the way things were back in their old home, is that right?

TÓNGXUÉ B: Shì a! Wáng Lǎoxiānsheng rén hěn hǎo, jiù shi yǒu diǎnr lǎo guānniàn, zǒng xiǎng bǎochí dà jiātíngde chuántǒng, kěshi jiālide niánqīng rén duōshù dōu bù tīng tāde huà, yǒu shíhou tā yě hěn bù gāoxìng.

CLASSMATE B: Yes! Mr. Wáng was a very good person, but he was a bit old-fashioned in his way of thinking. He always wanted to keep the tradition of the large family, but most of the young people in the family wouldn't listen to him. So sometimes he was very displeased.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Nǐ néng bu néng gěi wo jiǎngjiang ne?
CLASSMATE A: Can you tell me about it?
TÓNGXUÉ B: Xíng a! Wáng Lǎoxiānsheng yǒu wǔge érzi, tā yuànyi érzimen zǎohūn. Tā xiǎng, zǎo jiéhūn, zǎo yǒu sūnzi, nà duō hǎo!
CLASSMATE B: Sure! Mr. Wáng had five sons. He wanted his sons to marry early. He thought that if they got married young, he would get grandsons sooner, and how great that would be.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Zǎohūn, lǎorén yě kěyi zǎo yìdiǎnr yǒu zhàogu, zhè bú cuò.
CLASSMATE A: With early marriage, old people can be cared for sooner; that's good too.
TÓNGXUÉ B: Wáng Lǎoxiānsheng zhèng shi zhèige yìsi. Kěshi érzimen bú nàme xiǎng.
CLASSMATE B: That's exactly what Mr. Wáng had in mind. But his sons didn't think so.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Tāmen zěnme xiǎng?
CLASSMATE A: What did they think?
TÓNGXUÉ B: Tāmen shuō nèizhǒng "zǎohūn, jiāli láodònglì duō, shōurù jiù duō, shēnghuó jiù hǎo" de xiǎngfǎ shízài shi tài jiù le. Tāmen shi niánqīng rén, tāmende guānniàn dōu shi xīnde.

CLASSMATE B: They thought the idea that "early marriage brings the family more manpower, and therefore more income and a better life" is really too old. They're young people and all their ideas are new ones.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Wáng Lǎoxiānsheng zěnme bàn ne?
CLASSMATE A: What did Mr. Wáng do?
TÓNGXUÉ B: Hòulái tā mànmande yě míngbai xiànzài gēn guòqù wánquán bù tóng le, tā yě jiù bù shuō shénme le. Suǒyǐ yìzhí dào Wáng Xiānsheng sǐ, jiāli yě méiyou shénme dà wèntí.

CLASSMATE B: Later he gradually came to understand that things are completely different now from the way they used to be, so he stopped talking about it. So there weren't any big problems in the family up until Mr. Wáng died.
TÓNGXUÉ A: Hǎo le, wǒmen huàn ge tímù ba, tántan nǐde qíngxing. Nǐ zuìjìn zěnmeyàng? Niàn shū niànde hǎo bu hǎo?
CLASSMATE A: Okay, let's change the subject and talk about your situation. How have you been lately? Are your studies going well?
TÓNGXUÉ B: Bú cuò, jiù shi máng. Jīntian yǒu diǎn shíjiān xiūxi xiūxi, wǒmen qù hē chá hǎo bu hǎo?
CLASSMATE B: Pretty well, it's just that I'm busy. But today I have time to take a break. Let's go have some tea, okay?
TÓNGXUÉ A: Hǎo, zǒu ba!
CLASSMATE A: Okay, let's go!
